products.name: ChatGPT
products.key_insight: ChatGPT represents a paradigm shift in behavioral design: the product's interface IS the choice architecture. Every interaction requires the user to construct their own options (via prompts), which inverts the traditional Nudge Theory framework. This creates a fascinating paradox — the product that seems to give users 'infinite freedom' actually has enormous hidden defaults (training data biases, RLHF preferences, system prompt constraints) that shape every response.
